prompt:
Create a fictional SG-23 Breacher tactical shotgun concept for the Dear Human game wiki. Practical contemporary tactical design with restrained near-future detailing: a conventional robust metal receiver, short ventilated handguard, exposed upper barrel and a separate parallel lower magazine tube, pistol grip, adjustable skeletal shoulder stock, top rail and a small low-mounted optic. A thick dark cylindrical suppressor is attached to the muzzle and clearly reads as a separate accessory. Avoid bulky sculpted science-fiction armor shells and built-in sensor towers. Strong broad shotgun proportions. No box magazine.
Style: realistic 3D-render-style game equipment concept art. Matte gunmetal and dark graphite, crisp readable silhouette and restrained surface wear. Single complete object pointing right in near side profile, a little upper surface visible. Pale cool-gray seamless studio background, soft studio lighting. Landscape 1536x1024, whole object centered with ample margins. Exterior visual design only. No people, no firing scene, no text, no labels or diagrams.
